extras.Scope: This run is the delta from GSL-250 run-02 (score 100, closed) to a fully-green Phase 7 feature-complete dossier. GSL-250 stays closed on its own run-02; this run adds the four items GSL-297 closed: the snapshot end-check (GSL-298), the AskUserQuestion answer-loop live proof (GSL-299), the PermissionRequest allow/deny live proof (GSL-300), and the Fleet live-values proof + underlying flushPendingObservations fix (GSL-301).
extras.Isolation: All live-proof runs used an isolated scratch tree under `.artifacts/gsl297-live/`: scratch DB, scratch lab dir, scratch bearer + internal secret, dedicated port 7332. Zero touch on the production `data/gosleep.db` or the shared `docs/lab/`. The launchd-managed prod core was not restarted.
extras.Live gates: core-smoke: 96 PASS / 0 FAIL (was 90 before GSL-298's +5 and GSL-301's +1). bun test (apps/core): 191 PASS / 0 FAIL (unchanged). tsc apps/core clean. tsc apps/web clean. vite build 2.74 s. gate.sh --offline: not re-run in this dossier context (see 'What was NOT re-verified' below).

verdict.summary: Phase 7 acceptance is fully green after GSL-297. All seven R7.x requirements DELIVERED with evidence. All six end-check bullets DELIVERED, EXCLUDED (soak-gated), or MOVED (skills-management), each with a direct link. The one latent flush bug uncovered during GSL-301's verification pass was fixed in the same commit (`flushPendingObservations` UPDATE-vs-INSERT branch selector — Bun `.get()` returns null, not undefined) and fenced with a new core-smoke assertion. One remaining gap named honestly: no hook in tools/hooks/ CALLS /internal/agents/tool-observed today, so R7.4's live population is contingent on wiring a Session-level shim as a separate small follow-up task (owner-gated per d-2026-08-09-001). Widening interception to ALL sessions is the explicit next owner-gated step, documented in PRD + runbook section 8.

tasks_landed.title: [Web][Docs] Fleet live-values proof + flushPendingObservations bug fix

bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.bug: `prune_keep_last`'s empty-pipe case leaked exit 1 through `set -o pipefail` — every first snapshot on a fresh install returned rc=1 even though the .backup itself succeeded.
bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.fix: `|| true` on the while pipe + explicit `exit 0` at the tail, matching the header's 'Retention failures WARN and continue' contract.

bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.bug: Bun's `db.query(...).get(...)` returns `null` (NOT `undefined`) when no row matches — the branch selector `existing !== undefined` was true for a null result, so every fresh session_id took UPDATE not INSERT, UPDATE'd 0 rows, silently dropped the observation. First-time observations never landed in the DB.
bugs_uncovered_and_fixed.fix: `existing !== null && existing !== undefined` + removed the surrounding `db.raw.transaction(() => …)` wrapper (per-row atomicity is enough) + per-row try/catch that logs `core.tool_observed.flush_error` on failure. Regression fenced by core-smoke scenario 25b.

remaining_gaps.title: No hook in tools/hooks/ CALLS /internal/agents/tool-observed
remaining_gaps.impact: R7.4's live population is contingent on a Session-level PreToolUse shim that POSTs to the endpoint on every tool call. Without it, current_tool + context_pct only populate when something else POSTs (e.g. this run's proof via manual curl).
